messages:
Vikram Desai: Hey all 1st day snag: I accepted the org invite but GitHub only shows my work email (vikram@redwood.ai) as a secondary email on my account. The org page lists me as "Member" but when I try to open private repos it 404s. Any pointers?
Olivia Chen: Welcome Vikram! If the work email is secondary/unverified GH sometimes doesn't associate org membership fully for SAML. Can you check Settings -> Emails and see which email is primary and whether vikram@redwood.ai is verified?
Vikram Desai: vikram@redwood.ai is listed as secondary and says "unverified". I must've added it later. How do I fix without creating chaos on commit history?
access-bot: Note: Organization requires SAML SSO + verified work email for full repo access. If the invited email is not verified on the accepting account, admins may need to revoke and reissue.
Sam Miller: Two paths: 1) verify the work email on your existing account and make it primary (safe), 2) if you want to use a different GH account altogether we'll revoke and resend. Verifying is simplest. Click the verification link we sent to vikram@redwood.ai or resend from GH Settings -> Emails.
Vikram Desai: I can't find the verification email — it might have landed in spam. Can you resend the org invite after I mark the work email as primary?
Priya Rao: Resending the org invite isn't necessary if you verify the email. After verification, go to the org page and you may be prompted to "Authorize SAML". If not, ping here and we can trigger a sync.
Vikram Desai: OK I verified the email and promoted it to primary. The org page shows Member (SAML not authorized). There's a blue button "Authorize SAML" but clicking it redirects me to corporate IdP and returns me to the org page still stuck.
Olivia Chen: Sometimes the corporate IdP session is blocked by browser privacy settings or cookie profile. Try opening a fresh incognito window, sign into the correct GH account, then go to the org page and click authorize. Also clear third-party cookie blocking for github.com and your IdP domain.
Vikram Desai: Tried incognito and it completed the IdP flow. The org now shows Member (SAML authorized) and I can see repo list in the UI. But cloning over SSH gives "Permission denied (publickey)" — I had an SSH key on my old account.
Sam Miller: That means your current GH account (the one authorized) doesn't have the SSH public key. Add your ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub to GitHub -> Settings -> SSH and GPG keys on the verified account. Or if you prefer HTTPS, generate a PAT with repo scope and update credential helper.
Vikram Desai: Added SSH key to the verified account and `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/feature-flag.git` works now. One last thing: will team membership (eng-platform) be applied automatically?
Priya Rao: Our onboarding job usually provisions team access within ~30 minutes of SAML authorization. If it doesn't, @Sam Miller will add you manually.
Sam Miller: Confirmed: added Vikram Desai to eng-platform and eng-runtime with write access. You should see the team repos now.
Vikram Desai: Can see everything and pushed a change. Thanks for the quick help and the incognito tip!
thread_body_preview: New hire had work email as secondary/unverified causing SSO/membership hiccup; verified and promoted email, used incognito to complete IdP SAML authorize, added SSH key to correct account, admin added to teams.
